Left and right to change it.

The theme column suggests a street-ambience bed under the menu posters (audio asset, engine/audio owner to confirm; not a separate setting). Default 70 and step 5 are placeholders, engine to confirm.

speaker: narrator

OWNER DECISION needed: the effect column of the same row says 'Change the SFX on or off', which contradicts 'a slider'. Slider kept (0 = off) so both readings are covered; owner to choose slider vs on/off toggle. Default 80 and step 5 are placeholders.

gddGap: GDD is silent on audio focus behaviour. pause.md auto-pauses on tab blur (OQ-P3); this setting covers whether sound also drops.
speaker: narrator

Leave it on and your neighbours stay happy.
notes: Independent of auto-pause (pause.md). Browser tab blur event. Default On is a proposal.

speaker: narrator
lines: Fill the whole screen with the wall.
Esc leaves fullscreen first in most browsers.
notes: GDD menu docx table, Fullscreen row: function 'Makes the screen Fullscreen'; effect 'Makes the game screen big'. Phaser FIT scale at 1280x720 (flow.md A1). Browsers require a user gesture to enter fullscreen, so apply on Apply click/key press. Esc exits fullscreen at browser level and may collide with Back; implementer to verify. Toggle control and default Off are placeholders.

Poster B: Rust Notice 114 with 'CURFEW' struck through (hand-inked cross-out), brick red; shows the Rust security force's control and the community defacing it.
